feeds.title: MyFoxHurricane.com Blog
feeds.description: Everything you need to monitor the tropics in one place. Hurricane tracking, tropical models, and more storm coverage. Includes exclusive satellite and radar coverage of Florida, the Gulf of Mexico, and the Caribbean. Follow this blog for daily updates.

feeds.title: Storm Highway
feeds.description: Storm Highway covers extreme weather year-round in the Midwest, Great Plains and beyond. I focus primarily on the storm hazard during the winter months and the midwestern severe weather threat throughout the year. Get more information about storm chasing by following this feed.

feeds.title: CIMSS Satellite Blog » Tropical Hurricanes
feeds.description: The intent of this blog is to showcase examples of meteorological satellite imagery and products that are available to (or created by) scientists and researchers at NOAA's Cooperative Institute for Meteorological Satellite Studies (CIMSS), located at the University of Wisconsin - Madison's Space Science and Engineering Center (SSEC).

feeds.title: Tropical Atlantic Update
feeds.description: Brief summaries of tropical Atlantic activity designed for the general public, coastal residents, and weather enthusiasts. I have been sending out these updates continuously since 1996, and appreciate everyone's continued interest! Follow this blog for recent updates.
